assets.usage: 512 foam lace/billow/gradient bake, two-phase advection, erosion into lace, billow-normal lighting, crease occlusion and thin-foam tint adapted to existing Gerstner ocean. Existing derivative filtering retained. Forecast wave heights, directions and periods drive the same wave bank used for hull buoyancy. Full FFT/island/underwater/terrain pipeline not imported; archive contains no separate image or ocean-data packs.

notIntegrated.reason: Inspected actual PNG: stylised blue crown and dark outline unsuitable for the realistic water. Existing physical droplets/ripples retained. Duplicate archive not used.

Board layout/nails inappropriate for the supplied boat atlas. No stock wood colour replacement.
Photographic references, not seamless technical materials or animated lens-normal maps. Existing dynamic lens refraction retained.

validation.tests: 20 test scripts cover materials, boats, live forecasts, cache failures, astronomy and waves.
validation.visual: Live forecast fetched successfully in local browser. Clear night, textured moon, storm whitecaps and phone weather disclosure checked.
validation.limits: Desktop browser and 390px layout review; physical phone GPU unmeasured. Weather/marine are model estimates; currents and unavailable/historical weather remain simulated.
